newsitem.title: USA: Arafat says Palestinian convenant changed.
newsitem.headline: Arafat says Palestinian convenant changed.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat told U.S. Jewish leaders on Wednesday that 29 paragraphs in the Palestinian covenant calling for the elimination of the state of Israel have been annulled, a group spokesman said.

Arafat, meeting privately with 11 Jewish leaders before holding talks at the United Nations, said that the offending paragraphs were deleted because they were not consistent with the peace accords or the Oslo agreement, group spokesman Howard Squadron said.
"He said publicly that the offensive paragraphs are not there and have been annulled and that a Palestinian legal committee was working on a revised charter," Squadron said.
Jewish groups and Israel have long called for the Palestinians to annul those parts of their charter which call for the elimination of the Jewish state.

Squadron said that the Jewish group asked Arafat to deal directly with the Israeli government and not ask external groups like the United Nations, the United States and European Community to intervene and pressure Israel.

Arafat indicated that he would prefer to deal directly with Israel but noted that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had not informed him in advance of plans to build a Jewish housing project in Arab East Jerusalem, Squadron said.
